Game Overview

At its heart, Rotating Santa is a adventure game about guide Santa through a whimsical world as you rotate the landscape to gather lost presents. With 40 intricately designed levels, this festive adventure challenges your wits and strategy. Experience a delightful blend of puzzles and holiday cheer, where clever rotations reveal hidden paths to solve each Christmas challenge.

Playing Rotating Santa comes down to a simple loop. Guide Santa through a whimsical world as you rotate the landscape to gather lost presents.
